findings.title: Pre-0.30 new Program(idl, programId, provider)
findings.summary: Since Anchor 0.30 the constructor is `new Program(idl, provider?)`; the program id is read from `idl.address`. The old 3-argument form, still common in tutorials, passes the programId where the provider is expected.
findings.fix: Use `new Program(idl as MyProgram, provider)` with a 0.30+ IDL that contains `address`.

locations.snippet: export const program = new anchor.Program(idl as anchor.Idl, programId, provider);

findings.title: Hard-coded account missing or closed on-chain
findings.summary: A base58 pubkey hard-coded in source was not found via getMultipleAccounts on the configured cluster (null account). The address is closed, never existed, or belongs to a different cluster.
findings.fix: Replace the address with the current mainnet pubkey, or gate cluster-specific addresses behind an env/config switch.

findings.title: Hard-coded program ID is not executable on-chain
findings.summary: A pubkey used as a program ID (PublicKey passed to Program / named PROGRAM_ID / similar) exists but executable=false. Calling it as a program will fail at runtime.
findings.fix: Use the deployed program id for this cluster (check `solana program show` / the project's Anchor declare_id / IDL address).

findings.title: Keyless Hermes Quickstart now returns HTTP 401
findings.summary: The hermes-client README Quickstart builds `new HermesClient("https://hermes.pyth.network", {})` with no credentials. The public endpoint now rejects keyless price-update requests (/v2/updates/price/latest) with `401 unauthorized`, so getLatestPriceUpdates() and SSE streams fail at runtime.
findings.fix: Upgrade to @pythnetwork/hermes-client >= 3.1.0 and pass `{ accessToken: process.env.PYTH_HERMES_ACCESS_TOKEN }` (sent as `Authorization: Bearer *** or point the client at a provider-hosted Hermes endpoint.

findings.title: Raw keyless calls to hermes.pyth.network
findings.summary: Code calls the public Hermes REST/SSE endpoint directly (fetch/axios/curl) without an Authorization header or ACCESS_TOKEN. Keyless price-update requests now return HTTP 401.
findings.fix: Send `Authorization: Bearer *** (REST) or `?ACCESS_TOKEN=***` (SSE/WebSocket), or use @pythnetwork/hermes-client >= 3.1.0 with `accessToken`.

findings.title: Calls RPC methods removed from validators
findings.summary: web3.js 1.x still exposes helpers like getRecentBlockhash / getConfirmedTransaction / getFees, but Agave 2.x RPC nodes removed the underlying methods. They now fail with -32601 "Method not found" at runtime even though they type-check.
findings.fix: Use getLatestBlockhash, getTransaction, getSignaturesForAddress, getBlock/getBlocks, getFeeForMessage instead.

findings.title: Renamed to @anchor-lang/core in Anchor 1.0
findings.summary: Anchor 1.0 (and 0.31.2+ release notes) moved the TypeScript client to @anchor-lang/core; the @coral-xyz/* line is legacy and is not the supported path for new releases.
findings.fix: npm i @anchor-lang/core and replace imports from "@coral-xyz/anchor" (including dist/cjs/idl) with "@anchor-lang/core".

findings.title: Known devnet-only address used in a mainnet context
findings.summary: Source hard-codes an address that is documented as devnet-only (e.g. Pyth's devnet oracle program), while the doctor is probing a mainnet RPC.
findings.fix: Switch to the mainnet program id, or select addresses from a cluster map keyed by the active RPC.
findings.note: gSbePebf… is documented for devnet; RPC provider is public-mainnet

findings.title: Deprecated confirmTransaction(signature)
findings.summary: Passing a bare signature string (instead of a { signature, blockhash, lastValidBlockHeight } strategy) relies on a fixed timeout instead of blockhash expiry, so confirmations randomly time out or report false failures under load.
findings.fix: Call `connection.confirmTransaction({ signature, blockhash, lastValidBlockHeight }, commitment)` using the values from getLatestBlockhash().

findings.title: Hard-coded public mainnet-beta RPC URL
findings.summary: api.mainnet-beta.solana.com is rate-limited and not intended for production apps; examples that hard-code it start returning 429s under real traffic.
findings.fix: Read the RPC URL from configuration (e.g. process.env.SOLANA_RPC_URL) and use a dedicated RPC provider in production.

findings.title: Abandoned package (last release 2022)
findings.summary: The Anchor TS client moved to @coral-xyz/anchor in 0.27, and to @anchor-lang/core in Anchor 1.0. The old package never gets fixes or IDL-format support.
findings.fix: Replace with @anchor-lang/core (Anchor >= 1.0) or @coral-xyz/anchor (legacy 0.x) and update imports.

findings.title: No `accessToken` option before 3.1.0
findings.summary: The `accessToken` constructor option (Bearer auth for HTTP, ACCESS_TOKEN query param for SSE) first shipped in 3.1.0. Older versions can only authenticate by hand-rolling `headers: { Authorization }`, and SSE streams cannot be authenticated cleanly.

findings.title: Package is deprecated on npm
findings.summary: npm marks this package as deprecated and no longer maintained. Tutorials still reference it, but it will not receive the Hermes auth changes.

probe.detail: npm deprecated 1.11.0: "This package is deprecated and is no longer maintained. Please use @pythnetwork/hermes-client instead."

findings.title: web3.js 1.x is in maintenance mode
findings.summary: New development happens in @solana/kit (formerly web3.js 2.0). 1.x still works but receives fixes only.
findings.fix: Plan a migration to @solana/kit for new code; keep 1.x for libraries that still require it (e.g. Anchor clients).
